name: Build a DataViews table with filters and actions
query: Add a DataViews table to a WordPress plugin admin screen to browse pages with search, author/status filters, sorting, pagination, and bulk delete action.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route with wordpress-router to identify repo type
Step 2: Use wp-project-triage to detect build tooling and version constraints
Step 3: Choose DataViews and confirm correct import path (@wordpress/dataviews/wp when using @wordpress/scripts)
Step 4: Define data shape and id strategy (id field or getItemId)
Step 5: Define fields with types, filters, and sorting configuration
Step 6: Build a view config for search, filters, sort, perPage, and page
Step 7: Provide actions with supportsBulk for selection and implement callbacks
Step 8: Map view to server queries or use filterSortAndPaginate for client-side data
Step 9: Verify sorting/filtering/pagination and action execution
success_criteria: Uses DataViews with the correct import path
Defines fields and view config aligned by field ids
Implements bulk action and selection correctly
Explains how view changes update the data source
Includes verification steps for filters, sort, and pagination
